title: Watermelon tools
description: This addon adds a watermelon tools
body:
Watermelon Tools Mod 🍉
Transform ordinary watermelons into powerful weapons & tools!
New Items:

• Watermelon Sword ⚔️: Juicy blade deals solid damage to mobs, leaves splash effects on hit! Ideal for PvP & zombie hunting.

• Watermelon Pickaxe ⛏️: Netherite-tier mining speed for stone & ores, highly durable & stylish.

Crafting:
Sword: 2 Golden melon slice (middle) + 2 Stick (bottom).
Pickaxe: Standard recipe, 3 Golden melon slice + 2 Sticks.

Works with vanilla Minecraft (Forge).
Fun survival boost: Farm → Craft → Conquer!

Coming soon: Armor, bow & bosses.
